name: reolink-cli
description: Plugin for operating Reolink cameras through the local CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Discover, inspect, configure, preview, and control Reolink cameras locally.
interface.longDescription: Use the local Rust CLI to discover, log in to, inspect, configure, preview, and control Reolink cameras.
defaultPrompt: Discover nearby Reolink cameras and tell me which host or UID to use.
Log in to my configured Reolink camera and summarize model, firmware, and capabilities.
Capture a preview or move PTZ on the configured camera.
